description: Changes an existing assistant. Send only the fields the user named explicitly. Changing engine or llm_model changes the per-minute price: show call2me_estimate_call_cost first and get the user's OK. Model and engine changes (llm_model, engine, temperature, builtin_functions, system_prompt) keep every other engine setting. Unknown fields are rejected, never ignored.

backchannel_words.description: Custom backchannel words (empty list = language defaults).

begin_message.description: First sentence of every call (used when begin_message_mode is 'static').

begin_message_mode.description: 'static' says begin_message as-is; 'dynamic' lets the LLM write the greeting.

builtin_functions.description: Built-in actions the assistant may take during a call (replaces the list).

enable_backchannel.description: Short listening sounds ('mm-hm') while the caller talks.

end_call_message.description: Goodbye sentence said before hanging up.

engine.description: 'cascade' (speech-to-text, LLM, text-to-speech; default) or 'realtime' (GPT Realtime speech-to-speech, pricier per minute, needs an 'openai-*' voice).

interruption_sensitivity.description: How easily the caller can interrupt (0 hard, 1 easy; below 0.1 disables interruptions).

knowledge_base_ids.description: Knowledge base ids the assistant searches (replaces the list).

llm_model.description: LLM used by the cascade engine (OpenRouter id). Ignored by the realtime engine.

max_call_duration_ms.description: Hard cap on one call's length in ms (60000-7200000, default 3600000). Calls are billed per second, so this is also the most one call can cost.

metadata.description: Your own key/value data on the assistant. MERGED into the existing metadata (a key set to null is removed). The 'custom_functions' key cannot be set here.

post_call_actions.description: Actions to run after each call.

post_call_extraction.description: Data fields to extract from each call.

post_call_extraction_model.description: LLM that extracts post_call_extraction fields after each call (low-cost models only).

reminder_max_count.description: Reminders before the call is ended for silence (0-5; 0 turns off reminders AND silence hang-up, so a silent line stays open, and billed, until max_call_duration_ms). Silence hang-up time is about reminder_message_frequency_ms x (count + 1).

reminder_message_frequency_ms.description: After this much caller silence (ms, 3000-60000) the assistant speaks a reminder.

response_engine.description: Optional nested form of the engine fields; merged into the assistant's current engine. Prefer the top-level fields.

responsiveness.description: How fast the assistant replies after the caller stops (0 patient, 1 immediate).

transfer_targets.description: Where the assistant may transfer calls (replaces the list). A phone transfer is a billed outbound call; restricted destinations are refused.

name.description: Department name the caller asks for.

value.description: E.164 number, sip: URI, or agent id.

voice_id.description: Voice id from call2me_list_voices. Realtime engine needs an 'openai-*' voice; cascade cannot use 'openai-*' voices.

voicemail_action.description: hangup = end the call; leave_message = say voicemail_message, then end.

voicemail_detection_enabled.description: Outbound calls only: if the other side sounds like an answering machine ("leave a message", "not available"...), apply voicemail_action. Silence alone is NOT treated as voicemail.

voicemail_detection_timeout_ms.description: How long after the opening line to listen for an answering-machine greeting (ms).

voicemail_message.description: Message left on voicemail; {{variables}} are filled per call.

name: call2me_update_agent
title: Update assistant
